rewrites:
# mode clefflash: /opt/clefenv = Clef's model-card transformers (5.10.2) + torchvision 0.28.0 (cu126) over THIS image's
# torch 2.13.0 / triton 3.7.1 / fla 0.5.2 / decision_index (system site-packages), for Clef-flash's own loader and joint
# head (C arms). The system python (every conversion phase, the L arms, scoring) is untouched: transformers 5.17.0.
RUN python -m venv --system-site-packages --without-pip /opt/clefenv && \n    python -m pip --python /opt/clefenv/bin/python install --no-cache-dir "transformers==5.10.2" && \n    python -m pip --python /opt/clefenv/bin/python install --no-cache-dir "torchvision==0.28.0" --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu126 && \n    /opt/clefenv/bin/python -c "import torch, transformers, torchvision, fla, decision_index; from transformers import AutoProcessor, Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; from transformers.models.qwen3_5 import modeling_qwen3_5 as M; v = (transformers.__version__, torch.__version__.split('+')[0], torchvision.__version__.split('+')[0]); assert v == ('5.10.2', '2.13.0', '0.28.0'), v; assert hasattr(M, 'torch_chunk_gated_delta_rule'); print('clefenv', v)" && \n    python -c "import torch, transformers; v = (transformers.__version__, torch.__version__.split('+')[0]); assert v == ('5.17.0', '2.13.0'), v; print('system', v)"
COPY code/m1 /opt/ssdm/m1

clef_arms._comment: C-arm projection basis. proxy_rows_scored / proxy_clef_tokens: the 640 proxy600 rows within Clef's 16,384 limit (4 over, refused as exhausted in both arms) and their Clef-encoded (ssdm encoding) tokens, computed locally with baselines.clef_backend.ClefEncoder on the Clef-flash tokenizer. Row model = job-sgihj (jobs/clef_baseline/price.py SGIHJ). reference_slowdown = the x4 planning slowdown of job_params_index_full_reference.json (measured 2.373x on job-d2u54). conv_factor: the converted layers run convert.gdn's torch chunk kernel in fp32 (estimate, no receipt). startup: Clef loader + 19 GB snapshot sha256 verify (estimate).
